title: Baked Hake with Indian Spices
description: A flavorful Italian-inspired dish featuring baked hake in a yeasty and aromatic Indian spice blend.
instructions: Rinse the hake fillets and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Season the hake with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of Indian spice blend.
In a shallow dish, mix together the yeasty bread crumbs and a pinch of Indian spice blend.
Dip each hake fillet in the bread crumb mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated hake fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the hake fillets, then sprinkle with minced garlic.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
